source_contract_observations.observed_contract: Read-only requests to the official operation with Accept application/json, application/json plus text/csv, and text/csv all returned HTTP 200 application/octet-stream and the same CSV headed by 16 Traditional Chinese columns including 日期、商品名稱、買賣權別、身份別、交易口數買賣淨額 and 未平倉口數買賣淨額.
source_contract_observations.incident_evidence: Natural after-close map index 24 failed on both Airflow task tries with HTTP 200 JSONDecodeError at line 1 column 1. The retries logged application/octet-stream and 2789 bytes for their first two requests. The old allowlist mapped this source to taifex_json, so JSON decoding failed before normalization; zero raw rows were a fetch/parse failure, not zero positions.
source_contract_observations.decision: Use the existing taifex_csv adapter for this source only. Permit application/octet-stream only for this allowlisted key, enforce the exact 16-column CSV header set, and map official Chinese columns to canonical source fields through config aliases. Retain the source as market aggregate context, not an individual-stock directional vote.
source_contract_observations.local_verification: The BDD contract test failed against the old JSON mapping and passed after the adapter correction. The focused source-extension and HTTP-retry suites passed 19 tests; py_compile passed. A read-only request through the corrected parser returned 6 quality-ok normalized rows for effective_date 2026-10-30. On 2026-11-03 the natural after-close run then persisted 6/6 accepted with zero quarantine/duplicates; a read-only field check found all 6 records with 8 canonical target fields and 48 field rows.
source_contract_observations.runtime_state: Natural after-close run scheduled__2026-11-02T12:00:00+00:00 bootstrapped the DB registry to taifex_csv. Runtime and registry adapters match, contract drift is 0, task try 1 succeeded, and 6/6 accepted records have source-feed PIT versions. The previous waiting-for-natural-persistence gap is closed; continue to monitor subsequent scheduled batches.
source_contract_observations.freshness_and_role: The natural effective date is 2026-11-02 while the 2026-11-03 equity scan is dated one session later. This is market aggregate context with no listed/OTC equity denominator and cannot vote on individual stocks. Parser recovery does not imply same-day freshness or a permanent guarantee that the upstream contract will not change.
source_contract_observations.next_evidence_required: Continue checking future natural after-close runs for registry/runtime agreement, accepted/quarantine/duplicate counts, advancing effective dates and PIT versions. Do not manually trigger or replay the DAG.

source_contract_observations.incident_evidence: Natural runs succeeded with 1386 accepted rows on 2026-10-05, 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-12; failures on 2026-10-07 through 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-13 were HTTP 200 JSONDecodeError. On 2026-10-13 the complete response was application/octet-stream, 81511 bytes, with the official CSV attachment filename and UTF-8 BOM.
source_contract_observations.decision: The adapter accepts JSON only under application/json with required schema keys, CSV only with required headers, and application/octet-stream only with the exact official CSV filename; source body is not retained in diagnostics.

All 1386 records were consequently quarantined and no source_record_fields were stored. The 2026-10-08 JSON run had 1386 accepted rows and 13860 normalized field rows.
source_contract_observations.decision: Register exact official Chinese header aliases for each canonical field in the allowlisted source config, and use the same resolver for required-field checks and source-field persistence. Keep the CSV header allowlist strict and preserve raw source labels.
source_contract_observations.local_verification: Read-only replay of all 1386 persisted 2026-10-13 quarantined payloads through the new alias resolver yielded 1386 normalizer quality=ok, zero missing required fields, and 13860/13860 canonical field values resolvable without DB writes. 17 targeted tests passed; py_compile succeeded; worker Airflow list-import-errors returned []. These checks do not establish natural-run recovery.

source_contract_observations.next_evidence_required: The next natural-run condition was satisfied on 2026-10-15 by source_run 8638: 1386 accepted, zero quarantine/duplicates, effective_date 2026-10-14 and 13860 canonical source fields persisted. Continue monitoring subsequent freshness and persistence; this is market context only, not an equity direction feed.

failure_evidence.terminal_error: AirflowTaskTimeout while cursor.execute(TRUNCATE article_url) waited for an exclusive metadata lock
failure_evidence.database_evidence: A long-running SELECT joining article_url and news held shared metadata locks; six TRUNCATE attempts were waiting at the 2026-10-15 20:35 Asia/Taipei read-only processlist check.
failure_evidence.root_cause: The collector uses DDL TRUNCATE on a shared staging table. It requires an exclusive metadata lock and is vulnerable to a long-running reader; this is lock contention, not evidence of a publisher parser failure.

source_contract_observations.decision: Use DELETE FROM article_url for DML refresh and set max_active_runs=1 because downstream collection reads the shared staging table. This avoids the DDL-exclusive metadata lock and serializes the shared-table workflow.
source_contract_observations.local_validation: Targeted regression checks passed (2 passed); py_compile succeeded. No DAG was manually triggered and no news business rows were written for this investigation.
source_contract_observations.next_evidence_required: Satisfied by two subsequent natural scheduled runs on 2026-10-15 23:30 and 2026-10-16 05:30 Asia/Taipei. The latest 1036 accepted rows match storage XCom and actual per-source DB counts; see news_article_url_natural_recovery_20261016. Continue observing recurrence; the earlier reader owner remains unknown.
source_contract_observations.operational_cleanup: After confirming all linked Airflow runs were terminal-failed and no news DAG run was queued/running, canceled only the six waiting TRUNCATE statements. Follow-up processlist showed zero pending TRUNCATEs and one granted shared-read lock remaining; no news business rows were changed. The long-running reader was left untouched because its owner was unidentified.

source_contract_observations.persistence_validation: All 15 per-source accepted counts match actual rows at create_time 2026-10-16 05:37:45 and storage XCom. No article_url active statement or metadata lock was visible at 06:52 TPE.
source_contract_observations.decision: Confirm two natural post-fix recoveries for DML refresh and single-active-run serialization. Preserve source rejects, date precision and news historical-PIT limitations; two batches do not establish a long-run error rate.
source_contract_observations.next_evidence_required: Observe future natural runs for recurrence and source freshness. Earlier long-reader owner remains unknown; no process was canceled in this follow-up.

source_contract_observations.root_cause: The adapter allowed application/octet-stream only when Content-Disposition filename exactly matched the official CSV filename. The natural run was rejected before body read; the stored diagnostic cannot distinguish a missing filename from a different one and cannot establish the payload format.
source_contract_observations.decision: Allow application/octet-stream only for the allowlisted TAIFEX large-trader feed. Read within existing byte/row bounds and then require the full approved JSON keys or full CSV header. Keep all other source media-type allowlists unchanged.
source_contract_observations.local_verification: Old-code regression test failed on a valid synthetic TAIFEX CSV with application/octet-stream and no filename. After the change, 7 focused TAIFEX/media-isolation tests passed, py_compile succeeded, worker DagBag import_errors was empty, and local/worker adapter SHA matched.

source_contract_observations.next_evidence_required: The next scheduled natural after-close run must show accepted rows, effective date, schema-field persistence, and freshness; do not manually trigger or replay the DAG.

source_contract_observations.scope: intraday candidate loader and notification ledger
source_contract_observations.finding: A zero-new-candidate intraday run can follow source collection and material event classification when rows are filtered by policy or their dedupe key already has ledger status sent. Candidate count alone does not show selected rows, policy exclusions, dedupe suppressions, or receipt quality.
source_contract_observations.decision: Persist per-run filter and dedupe counts; report ledger sent separately from HTTP receipt and human reading. Do not resend an ambiguous historical sent row solely because its receipt is absent.

source_contract_observations.scope: automated signal notification and maturity follow-up lifecycle
source_contract_observations.natural_evidence: Daily scan used effective market date 2026-10-22 and produced 22 candidates; candidate digest formatter failed deterministically because one embed was 10700 bytes against a 10000-byte request budget. The separate failure notice had HTTP 200 and receipt; the candidate digest did not. Follow-up diagnostics referenced max_high_excursion_pct, absent from deployed market_signal_followups, whose canonical columns are max_favorable_excursion_pct and max_adverse_excursion_pct.
source_contract_observations.decision: Move four non-directional background fields into a separate embed and split within existing request limits. Align query/schema/summary code to the already-deployed favorable/adverse excursion columns; do not add a migration.
source_contract_observations.offline_verification: Same-cutoff replay retained all eight candidate cards in ten requests with maximum 9244 bytes; lifecycle tests, BDD formatter contract, compile and Airflow DagBag/import check passed. No candidate digest was sent by the replay.
source_contract_observations.next_natural_evidence_required: Confirm a later natural daily digest delivery receipt and non-empty horizon/follow-up persistence before treating either repair as production-accepted.

operational_runtime_observations.scope: Airflow source-extension package import and scheduled source writes
operational_runtime_observations.root_cause: A literal backslash-n line in dags/source_extension/__init__.py caused SyntaxError and DagBag import errors for modules using the package.
operational_runtime_observations.repair: Removed the stray literal line. A BDD package-import contract failed before the fix and passed afterward; Airflow DagBag then reported no import errors.
operational_runtime_observations.natural_evidence: The scheduler ran the overdue scheduled after-close and intraday runs after the import repair. Five mapped source writes first hit MySQL error 1213 deadlock; the existing single retry succeeded for all five. Final after-close 32/32 and intraday 10/10 source rows succeeded with zero contract drift.
operational_runtime_observations.decision: Keep the existing single retry for now. Treat this run as transient database contention, not source-format failure; monitor retry frequency before changing concurrency or transaction behavior.
operational_runtime_observations.pending_validation: The 2026-10-26 daily signal child was skipped by the market-closed gate, so the prior digest byte-budget and follow-up schema fixes still lack post-fix natural daily delivery and horizon-row evidence.
